_meta.description: 3-stage ProcessChain decorated with one whole-chain OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_STAGE spec (Ref.Stage.Index=0, Target.Stage.Index=2). Each stage preserves SERIES shape (grouper + scalar aggregator on region) so the whole-chain shape gate accepts: stage 0 sums revenue per region (label v), stage 1 sums v per region (label w), stage 2 counts w per region (label c). The post-finalize whole-chain barrier compares the stage 2 result against the stage 0 baseline and emits one OverlayLayer on ChainResponse.Overlays whose SeriesPayload carries per-region indices (100 * stage2 / stage0). Whole-chain overlays operate AFTER every stage finishes — the per-stage overlay slot on ChainStage.Request.Overlays stays untouched. Buffered: every E6 whole-chain kind is currently OverlayStreamability=false because the post-stage barrier runs after stage finalisation.
_meta.name: chain-whole-chain-index-vs-stage
